from fractions import Fraction as F
import json, random
from observational_succ.lonely_runner_census import residual_gaps, single_band_winding, gap_velocity_cap
from observational_succ.lonely_runner_verify import exact_maxmin
rng=random.Random(20261028)
records=[]
for n in range(5,11):
    for case in range(20):
        r1,r2=sorted(rng.sample(range(1,n),2))
        w1,w2=sorted(rng.sample(range(n,4*n+1),2))
        source=tuple(i for i in range(1,n) if i not in (r1,r2))+(w1,)
        gaps=residual_gaps(n,source)
        failed=next(((a,b) for a,b in gaps if single_band_winding(n,w2,a,b) is None),None)
        by_gaps=failed is None
        maximum=exact_maxmin(source+(w2,),[[0,1]]*(n-1))
        numerator,denominator=maximum["gamma"]
        by_maximum=numerator*n<=denominator
        assert by_gaps==by_maximum,(n,r1,r2,w1,w2)
        cap=gap_velocity_cap(n,gaps) if gaps else None
        if cap is not None and w2>cap:
            assert not by_maximum,(n,r1,r2,w1,w2,"width false rejection")
        pair=lambda x:[x.numerator,x.denominator]
        records.append({"n":n,"case":case,"removed":[r1,r2],"inserted":[w1,w2],
                        "gap_count":len(gaps),"gap_width_cap":cap,"cover_by_gap_test":by_gaps,
                        "first_failed_gap":None if failed is None else [pair(x) for x in failed],
                        "cover_by_pair_breakpoint_maximum":by_maximum,"exact_maxmin":maximum})
assert len(records)==120
print(json.dumps({"seed":20261028,"cases":records,"status":"PASS"},sort_keys=True,indent=2))

from itertools import combinations
import json, random
from observational_succ.lonely_runner_census import residual_gaps, single_band_winding, gap_velocity_cap
from observational_succ.lonely_runner_verify import exact_maxmin
positives={(5,1,3,6,8),(8,2,3,11,13)}
pool=[]
for n in range(5,11):
    for r1,r2 in combinations(range(1,n),2):
        source=tuple(v for v in range(1,n) if v not in (r1,r2))
        for w1 in range(n,2*n+1):
            gaps=residual_gaps(n,source+(w1,))
            if not gaps:
                raise AssertionError("missing one-insertion hole")
            cap=gap_velocity_cap(n,gaps)
            for w2 in range(w1+1,min(cap,4*n)+1):
                case=(n,r1,r2,w1,w2)
                if case not in positives:
                    pool.append(case)
assert len(pool)>=60
selected=random.Random(20261029).sample(pool,60)+sorted(positives)
records=[]
for n,r1,r2,w1,w2 in selected:
    source=tuple(v for v in range(1,n) if v not in (r1,r2))+(w1,)
    gaps=residual_gaps(n,source)
    cap=gap_velocity_cap(n,gaps)
    assert w2<=cap
    failed=next(((a,b) for a,b in gaps if single_band_winding(n,w2,a,b) is None),None)
    by_gaps=failed is None
    maximum=exact_maxmin(source+(w2,),[[0,1]]*(n-1))
    numerator,denominator=maximum["gamma"]
    assert by_gaps==(numerator*n<=denominator),(n,r1,r2,w1,w2)
    if (n,r1,r2,w1,w2) in positives:
        assert by_gaps and maximum["gamma"]==[1,n]
    pair=lambda x:[x.numerator,x.denominator]
    records.append({"n":n,"removed":[r1,r2],"inserted":[w1,w2],"gap_width_cap":cap,
                    "positive_control":(n,r1,r2,w1,w2) in positives,"cover":by_gaps,
                    "first_failed_gap":None if failed is None else [pair(x) for x in failed],
                    "exact_maxmin":maximum})
print(json.dumps({"seed":20261029,"eligible_noncontrol_pool_size":len(pool),"cases":records,"status":"PASS"},sort_keys=True,indent=2))
